title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0000e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.157394
  m_eff = 2.3452e-1 eV
  T_vev = 1.7823e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.1879 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0100 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.053233 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -2.087e+0
  J_spin = 4.603e-2
